Method of Attack: BotenaGo: exploits IoT devices using multiple exploits; Lillin scanner variant targets Lilin DVR devices using a two-year-old critical remote code execution flaw; uses hardcoded credentials to execute arbitrary code remotely; downloads and executes Mirai payloads
Fodcha: uses the same Lilin DVR remote code execution exploit to launch distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks
Mirai: payloads executed on compromised devices to target a wider list of exploits and devices; includes IP range exclusions to avoid infecting certain organizations
BadBox: referenced as a botnet infecting millions of devices (no detailed method of attack in text)
Attack Vector: Remote code execution via POST requests to dvr/cmd or cn/cmd endpoints with malicious payloads
Use of hardcoded credentials to authenticate and execute code
Downloading and executing wget.sh script from IP 136.144.41.169
Indicators of Compromise: POST requests to dvr/cmd and cn/cmd endpoints
Mirai payloads uploaded to VirusTotal as recently as March 2022
